2027-01-28.title: Thursday after Kohne Sunday · St Thomas Aquinas
readings: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever
I am the way, and the truth, and the life
2027-01-28.alt: Season of Denho. Alternative Gospel: Matthew 24:45–51. Commemoration of Fr John Kuzhinapurath OIC (+1995), a companion of Mar Ivanios in the 1930 reunion. St Thomas Aquinas, Doctor of the Church.
2027-01-28.verse: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
theo: Hebrews gives a community in change three anchors. Remember your leaders who spoke God's word to you, and imitate their faith. Hold to Christ, who does not change: “Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.” And worship in two ways: “let us continually offer a sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of lips that confess his name. Do not neglect to do good and to share what you have, for such sacrifices are pleasing to God.” Praise and charity are the Christian's sacrifices.

In the Gospel Jesus comforts his troubled disciples: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. Believe in God, believe also in me. In my Father's house there are many dwelling places.” Thomas asks: “Lord, we do not know where you are going. How can we know the way?” And Jesus answers with one of the greatest sentences of the Gospel: “I am the way, and the truth, and the life.” In this week of Kohne we remember the priests who showed us that way, among them Fr John Kuzhinapurath, and St Thomas Aquinas, who gave his mind to the Truth and his heart to the Life.
outline: Ask: who first showed you the way to God?
Point 3 · The way, the truth, the life
“I am the way, and the truth, and the life.”
live: Pray for a priest, living or departed, who helped your faith.
Share something you have with someone in need.
2027-01-28.prayer: Lord Jesus Christ, the same yesterday and today and forever, you are the way, the truth and the life. Grant eternal rest to Fr John Kuzhinapurath and all our departed priests; through the prayers of St Thomas Aquinas give us minds that seek truth and hearts that offer praise and charity. Amen.
altar: Through Christ the priest we offer the sacrifice of praise; at the altar he who is the Way leads us to the Father.

quick: Remember your leaders and imitate their faith.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today and forever.
Jesus is the way, the truth and the life.
2027-01-28.action: Pray for a priest who helped your faith.
2027-01-28.question: Do I follow Jesus as the way, or do I make my own road?

family.explain: Jesus told his friends not to be worried, because he is preparing a home for them in heaven. He is the way to get there!
family.intention: We pray for priests, especially those who have died.
family.ask: Ask: “Which priest has helped our family? Let us pray for him.”

illus: A woman in Thiruvalla keeps a small notebook with the names of every priest who has served her parish since her childhood. Each Kohne week she prays for them one by one. She says: they showed me the way; the least I can do is walk them home with my prayers.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, way, truth and life, lead us to the Father and bless your priests. Amen.
share: Remember your leaders (Hebrews 13:7). Whose faith do I imitate?
The same yesterday and today and forever (Hebrews 13:8). Do I trust Christ in times of change?
I am the way (John 14:6). Where do I need his direction?
interc: For departed priests, especially Fr John Kuzhinapurath.
For students and teachers, through St Thomas Aquinas.
For our group, that we may share what we have.
pm.close: Father, your Son is the way to you. Keep us faithful on that way until we reach your house. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Hebrews says: remember your leaders, those who spoke the word of God to you; consider the outcome of their way of life, and imitate their faith (Hebrews 13:7). In this Kohne week we remember departed priests, among them Fr John Kuzhinapurath.
Leaders pass, but Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever (Hebrews 13:8). Our sacrifices are praise and sharing: do not neglect to do good and to share what you have (Hebrews 13:16).
In the Gospel Jesus says: do not let your hearts be troubled. Thomas asks: how can we know the way? Jesus answers: I am the way, and the truth, and the life (John 14:6).
St Thomas Aquinas gave his mind to the Truth and his heart to the Life. Let us follow the Way, praise God, share with others and pray for our priests. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus said: I am the way! He shows us how to go to heaven. Let us pray for the priests who teach us about Jesus.

intro: Theme: “I am the way, and the truth, and the life.”
Faithful leaders, the unchanging Christ, and the Way to the Father.

q: For I the LORD do not change; therefore you, O children of Jacob, have not perished.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
points.apply: Bring one anxiety about change to the unchanging Christ.

q: For I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
Do not neglect to do good and to share what you have, for such sacrifices are pleasing to God.
points.apply: Share something with someone in need.

sub: No one comes but through me.
q: You show me the path of life. In your presence there is fullness of joy; in your right hand are pleasures forevermore.
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
points.apply: Pray for a priest who showed you the way.

concl: Christ does not change; he is the way home.
Praise, share, and remember those who led us.
2027-01-28.resolve: Pray each day this week for departed priests.
